infoLinks.urlText: Allow extra travel time as Kiss and Ride upgrade is underway at Leppington Station
infoLinks.content:
Road work is underway to improve the Kiss and Ride zone north of Leppington Station.
  • A reduced speed limit of 40km/h will be in place on the approach to Leppington Station from both directions.
  • A temporary Kiss and Ride zone is available in the commuter car park south of Leppington Station.
  • Access to the multi-storey commuter car park will remain open.
  • Work will take place between 7am to 6pm, Monday to Friday and 8am to 1pm on Saturdays.
Please allow extra travel time. View the project page for more information on the upgrade.

infoLinks.urlText: Buses replace metro services between Tallawong and Chatswood. Use trains between Epping or Chatswood and Sydenham
infoLinks.content:
Saturday 24 and Sunday 25 January 
  • Metro services do not run between Tallawong and Sydenham. Testing is underway for Southwest Metro.
  • Buses replace services between Tallawong and Chatswood only.
  • For travel to and from Waterloo use local buses or trains from Redfern.

  • Trackwork also affects trains in the City. For travel between Epping or Chatswood and Sydenham use:
    • T9 trains between Epping and Central or T1 trains between Chatswood and Wynyard
    • L2 or L3 light rail services between Wynyard and Central
    • T4 trains between Martin Place and Sydenham.
Read more about weekend service changes in the City here. 
 
  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus routes

10M Epping, all stations to Chatswood and return
11M Tallawong, all stations to Chatswood and return
12M Tallawong, all stations to Epping, then North Ryde, Chatswood and return
 
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.

infoLinks.urlText: Maitland school buses - service changes
infoLinks.content:
From 27 January 2026, timetable and route path changes will take effect on some Maitland school bus services and regular route services.

  • Additional weekend services for the route 185.

infoLinks.urlText: Buses replace trains from Blacktown to Penrith, in that direction only
infoLinks.content:
Monday 12 and Tuesday 13 January
  • Nightly from 11.50pm to 2.30am, buses replace trains from Blacktown to Penrith, in that direction only.
  • Trains run from Penrith to Blue Mountains Line stations, some to a changed timetable.
  • T1 Western Line trains run between Central and Blacktown. You may need to catch an earlier T1 train to ensure you meet your Blue Mountains bus and train connection.
  • The last train to Blue Mountains Line stations leaves Central at 23:10, arriving Mount Victoria at 01:31.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus routes
71T1 Blacktown, express to Penrith
72T1 Blacktown, all stations to Penrith
 
Replacement buses

infoLinks.urlText: Change to Rutherford Technology High School bus services and pass requirements from 26 May
infoLinks.content:
From Monday 26 May, students travelling in the morning from the Rutherford and Aberglasslyn areas to Rutherford Technology High School are to use the 2712 service (operated by CDC NSW), instead of the S520 service (operated by Grace Coaches).

What's changing:
  • There is a slight timetable difference between the S520 and 2712, so please check TripPlanner to plan your journey.
  • Students on the 2712 service by CDC NSW will need an Opal card. If you don’t already have one, find out more about how to apply for a pass.
  • The 2712 will drop students closer to Rutherford Technology High School than the S520 previously did – arriving at Alexandra Ave after Weblands St (232097) at 08:32.
  • Afternoon travel is not affected.

  • Plan your trip and check timetables before you travel.

infoLinks.urlText: The new Sydney Fish Market is opening Monday 19 January
infoLinks.content:
Wentworth Park is the closest light rail stop on the L1 Dulwich Hill Line, located approximately 400 metres from the new market.

Existing bus routes 389 and 501 serving Pyrmont and Ultimo will continue to provide access to the new Sydney Fish Market. These services operate along Harris Street and bus stops are just a 400 metre walk from the new Sydney Fish Market.

The Fish Markets light rail stop will be renamed Bank Street. From 19 January, visitors should disembark at Wentworth Park light rail stop.

Plan your trip at transportnsw.info

infoLinks.urlText: Station Update - Bardwell Park
infoLinks.content:
Access to Bardwell Park Station is via temporary stairs on the eastern side of Hartill-Law Avenue to enable the demolition of the existing station stairs and construction of new stairs and a lift on the western side of Hartill-Law Avenue. Allow extra time to safely cross the road at the signalised pedestrian crossing at the corner of Hartill-Law Avenue and Slade Road.

Please also note that there are no public toilets available at this station until further notice.

infoLinks.urlText: Valla Beach Road diversion – bus service changes
infoLinks.content:
From 12 January 2026, roadworks at Valla Beach Road will require buses on routes 358, 360 and 360X between Macksville, Coffs Harbour and Bellingen to divert.

The diversion will add time to all buses operating to/from Valla Beach. Some other timetables will also be adjusted due to this diversion.

No bus will depart earlier than its normal time.

The changes are expected to be in place for approximately two weeks.

Plan your trip for real-time up to date information.
 
Bus routes affected:
  • 358 – Macksville to Bellingen via Nambucca Heads & Urunga
  • 360 - Macksville to Park Beach Plaza via Nambucca Heads, Urunga & Toormina
  • 360X - Macksville to Coffs Harbour Park Ave via Nambucca Heads (Express Service)

infoLinks.urlText: Sydney CBD diversions on Australia Day
infoLinks.content:
From 7.30pm until 10.30pm on Monday 26 January, route 304, 333, 343 & 396 services will start and end trips at Martin Place due to road closures in place for Australia Day events.  
 
Services travelling towards Circular Quay will end trips at Martin Place, Elizabeth St, Stand C (2000421). 
 
Services travelling away from the city will start trips from Martin Place, Elizabeth St, Stand E (2000283). 
 
Stops between Martin Place and Circular Quay will be missed in both directions. Check signs at stops, catch trains or continue on foot. 
 
For more details on additional transport services and changes, visit the Australia Day event page. 
 
Missed stops: 
  • Museum of Sydney, Phillip St (200059)  
  • Circular Quay, Young St, Stand D (200065) (333, 396 only) 
  • Circular Quay, Alfred St, Stand A (2000147) (304, 343 only) 
  • Circular Quay, Alfred St, Stand B (20002) (333, 396 only) 
  • Phillip St opp Museum of Sydney (200068)

infoLinks.urlText: Buses replace trains between Central and Bondi Junction. Trains do not stop at Wolli Creek
infoLinks.content:
Wednesday 21 and Thursday 22 January  
  • Nightly from 9.50pm to 1.30am, buses replace trains between Central and Bondi Junction.
  • Trackwork buses do not leave from Martin Place Station.
  • Trains run to a changed timetable between South Coast Line stations and Central, platforms 1-14.
  • Change at Central for buses to Kings Cross, Edgecliff and Bondi Junction or metro services to Martin Place.

  • Nightly from 10.40pm to 1.30am, trains do not stop at Wolli Creek but make extra stops at Arncliffe and Sydenham.
  • Buses run between Sydenham, Wolli Creek and Arncliffe.
  • Change at Arncliffe or Sydenham for a bus to Wolli Creek or change at Central for a T8 Airport train if you have luggage or accessibility needs.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus routes

20T4 Bondi Junction, Edgecliff, Kings Cross, Central and return (bypassing Martin Place)
23T4 Bondi Junction, Town Hall and return
36T4 Arncliffe, Wolli Creek, Sydenham and return
324/325 City, Walsh Bay to Watsons Bay via Town Hall (Park St), Kings Cross, Edgecliff stations and return
333 City to Bondi Beach via Martin Place and Bondi Junction stations and return
 
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.

infoLinks.urlText: Parramatta Rd - Burwood, permanent bus stop closures
infoLinks.content:
Sydney Metro West construction work at Burwood will permanently close the following bus stops:
 
From 4am Monday, 4 April 2022
  • Parramatta Rd before Burwood Rd (213412) will be closed.
    The alternative stop for 415, 461X, 461N and 530 services will be Burwood Rd at Esher Lane (213431).
  • Parramatta Rd after Burwood Rd (213722) will be closed.
    The alternative stop for 415, 416X, 461N and 530 services will be Burwood Rd before Parramatta Rd (213462).

From 6am Monday 4 April 2022:
  • Parramatta Rd before Burwood Rd (213412) will be closed.
    Customers for the N70, N71, N80 and N81 services should use the new stop on Parramatta Rd, after Burwood Rd (213460).
  • Parramatta Rd after Burwood Rd (213722) will be closed.
    Customers for the N70, N71, N80 and N81 towards City Town Hall should use the alternate stop on Parramatta Rd opp Neichs Pde (213721).

infoLinks.urlText: Station Update - Macquarie Fields
infoLinks.content:
Station Access Changes

  • Plan your trip for real-time up to date information.

infoLinks.urlText: Buses replace trains between Central and Bondi Junction. Trains do not stop at Wolli Creek
infoLinks.content:
Wednesday 21 and Thursday 22 January  
  • Nightly from 9.50pm to 1.30am, buses replace trains between Central and Bondi Junction.
  • Trackwork buses do not leave from Martin Place Station, use metro services.
  • Most trains run to a changed timetable between Waterfall or Cronulla and the City Circle, with some making extra stops at St Peters and Erskineville.
  • Change at:
    • Sydenham or Central for metro services to Martin Place
    • Central for buses to Kings Cross and Edgecliff
    • Town Hall for express buses to Bondi Junction
  • Nightly from 10.10pm to 1.30am, trains do not stop at Wolli Creek but make an extra stop at Arncliffe.
  • Buses run between Sydenham, Wolli Creek and Arncliffe.
  • Change at Arncliffe or Sydenham for a bus to Wolli Creek or change at Central for a T8 Airport train if you have luggage or accessibility needs.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus routes

20T4 Bondi Junction, Edgecliff, Kings Cross, Central and return (bypassing Martin Place)
23T4 Bondi Junction, Town Hall and return
36T4 Arncliffe, Wolli Creek, Sydenham and return
324/325 City, Walsh Bay to Watsons Bay via Town Hall (Park St), Kings Cross, Edgecliff stations and return
333 City to Bondi Beach via Martin Place and Bondi Junction stations and return
 
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.
